title: Best Team With No Conflicts
summary: You manage a basketball team for a tournament.
statement: You manage a basketball team for a tournament. Select a team with the highest score, where score is the sum of individual player scores. Avoid conflicts where a younger player scores higher than an older player. Given scores and ages of players, find the maximum score of a non-conflicting team.
constraints: Equal-length arrays with 1–1,000 players; ages and scores are positive.
A conflict occurs only when a younger selected player has a strictly higher score than an older selected player.
hints: After sorting by age, a valid team has nondecreasing scores; equal ages may appear in either score order when sorted as pairs.
Use weighted longest nondecreasing subsequence DP over age-score pairs.
For each player, extend every earlier state whose score is at most the current score, then add the current score.
Age order handles younger-versus-older comparisons, and nondecreasing scores exclude exactly the forbidden inversion.
editorial: Age order handles younger-versus-older comparisons, and nondecreasing scores exclude exactly the forbidden inversion.

tests.explanation: Scores rise with age, so selecting everyone gives thirty-four.
The best compatible selection has total score sixteen.
